actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.send_ebook_download_links.descri: Creates a transaction for an eBook and sends the download link(s) to your customer. Returns the download link you can deliver by email or any other channel.
The customer's email address where the download instructions will be sent.
Your order or transaction reference number (e.g. from your eCommerce platform). Used for tracking and reporting.
Number of download links to generate. Use 1 for a single copy. Increase for multi-seat or multi-device licenses.
Select the eBook to send to your customer.
Only applies when the eBook uses **Social DRM (EditionMark)**. This email will be embedded as a watermark. Leave empty for Adobe DRM or Readium LCP books.
Only applies when the eBook uses **Social DRM (EditionMark)**. The customer's name will be embedded as a visible watermark in the eBook. Leave empty for Adobe DRM or Readium LCP books.
Only applies when the eBook uses **Social DRM (EditionMark)**. This phone number will be embedded as a watermark. Leave empty for Adobe DRM or Readium LCP books.
auth.description:
Your EditionGuard API token.

**How to get your API token:**
1. Log in to your [EditionGuard dashboard](https://app.editionguard.com)
2. Go to **Settings** (top-bar menu)
3. Find the **API** section and copy your **Rest API Token**
description: Secure eBook DRM and fulfillment — protect and deliver EPUB, MOBI, and PDF files with Adobe DRM, Readium LCP, or Social DRM.
